label: General surgery / Department of Surgery (unspecified division)
inclusion_rule: Appointment in a department named Surgery with no qualifying division recorded
exclusion_rule: Do not use when the department string names a nonsurgical division that merely sits administratively under Surgery

label: Cardiac or cardiothoracic surgery
inclusion_rule: Division or department string contains cardiac/cardiothoracic/thoracic surgery
exclusion_rule: Cardiology and interventional cardiology are excluded

label: Vascular surgery
inclusion_rule: Division or department string contains vascular surgery or endovascular surgery
exclusion_rule: Vascular medicine and interventional radiology are excluded

label: Transplant surgery
inclusion_rule: Division string contains transplant surgery or abdominal transplantation

label: Surgical oncology
exclusion_rule: Medical and radiation oncology are excluded

label: Trauma / acute care surgery / surgical critical care
inclusion_rule: Division string contains trauma surgery acute care surgery or surgical critical care

label: Colorectal surgery
inclusion_rule: Division string contains colon and rectal or colorectal surgery

label: Neurological surgery
inclusion_rule: Department or division named neurosurgery or neurological surgery

label: Orthopedic surgery
inclusion_rule: Department or division named orthopedics or orthopaedic surgery
exclusion_rule: Rheumatology and physical medicine are excluded

label: Plastic and reconstructive surgery
inclusion_rule: Department or division named plastic surgery

label: Otolaryngology - head and neck surgery
inclusion_rule: Department or division named otolaryngology or head and neck surgery
exclusion_rule: Audiology and speech pathology alone are excluded

label: Ophthalmology where organized as a surgical department
inclusion_rule: Ophthalmology appointment WITH dated evidence the unit is institutionally organized as a surgical department or a division of surgery
exclusion_rule: Freestanding departments or institutes of ophthalmology without such evidence stay broad-only

label: Obstetrics and gynecology
exclusion_rule: Not enumerated in the Section 7 taxonomy; retained as a documented borderline for sensitivity analysis only

label: Other explicitly surgical department or division
inclusion_rule: Unit name contains the word surgery or surgical and is a clinical appointment
exclusion_rule: Research centers with surgery in the name but no clinical appointment are excluded

label: Recorded but uninformative department value
exclusion_rule: Treated as unknown for surgical status

label: No department evidence
exclusion_rule: Never counted as surgical; published in coverage statistics
